# Acceptance matrix — preserve Deck3 v1.6 while adding orchestration

| Gate | Guard | Failure response |
|---|---|---|
| G0: Research authority | Frozen title/objectives, full P/T_e composition, extreme-heat scope, units and source precedence unchanged | BLOCK/OPEN; no arbitrary correction |
| G1: Scope and claim | No assumed bidirectional heat coupling; qualified/candidate arrows only | BLOCK diagram until source/label fixed |
| G2: Family and specialist | Each task has one primary specialist; helpers conditional, no substituting design for physics | Re-route |
| G3: Deck stage | Stage 1 editable native text + genuinely blank figure slot; Stage 2 standalone art; Stage 3 lossless assembly | Block assembly |
| G4: Palette | Exactly 13 original v1.6 sRGB tokens, white surfaces, exact institutional exceptions, authentic photographs | Reject unauthorized authored marks |
| G5: Geometry | Eligible figure share goal 75% meaningful usable area; acceptable 70–80% or authorized exception | Do not certify legacy small-slot output |
| G6: Mathematical correctness | Equations, units, domains, singularities, constraints, time meaning and independent references | PROVISIONAL until tests pass |
| G7: Evidential honesty | No random-looking synthetic art promoted to data, topology, physical noise or recovery | Label synthetic / remove claim |
| G8: Audience communication | Source-adjacent citations, readable labels at projection scale, non-decorative arrows, retained notes | Block figure/release |
| G9: Editability and reproducibility | Frozen-string digests, source/renderer, hashes, figure registry, editable PPTX text | Block until reproduced |
| G10: Human QA | Inspect PPTX/render visually and, for animation, actual supported playback | Distinguish technical from visually certified |
| G11: Tool honesty | Explicit tests actually executed, run version, warnings, missing Actions and blockers | Never claim PASS without proof |

**Specific preserved limitation:** Current `deck3/examples/deck3.py` uses a legacy smaller figure slot. A v1.7 skills router does not change its runtime geometry or confer 75%-occupancy compliance. Upgrade the generator through a **separate** targeted, render-tested PR.

**Existing frozen content must not be edited by this release.** `Deck3 text`, `Deck3 figures`, `Deck3 assemble`, `Deck3 all` retain exact command meaning. All references to "mandatory 13 colors" refer to the **MSE thesis design scope**, not external educational art repositories.
